interpretation: Across 10,000 canonical-C2 scenarios: 97.0% of attacker spawns are viable on the FIRST draw (no resampling needed); the remaining 3.0% require a mean of ~1.05 resamples among those resampled (max 2). Zero scenario_generation_failures (no seed exhausted 100 attempts). The obstacle field and asset initialization are IDENTICAL between the unconditioned and viability-conditioned runs for every one of the 10,000 seeds (0 mismatches), confirming by direct measurement -- not just by code inspection -- that conditioning never regenerates/perturbs the obstacle layout or asset trajectory. The accepted attacker-state distributions (range, speed, heading, nearest-obstacle distance) are materially UNCHANGED from the unconditioned distributions (means/medians/percentiles shift by <2% in every dimension), confirming the viability condition excludes only a narrow, rare slice of initial states rather than materially reshaping the benchmark's geometry distribution.
